title: Answerwell: live Confluence REST read-path benchmark
recordType: Curated summary of an existing development-site benchmark; not a new run

method.data: Generated content in a dedicated performance space
method.client: The application's own read functions, called through its real REST client from WSL2 in California
method.authentication: Test-user basic authentication, not the Forge bridge

before.method: Fetch a 200-question window and sort locally

after.method: Use CQL ordering and fetch 25 rows

limitations: Excludes the Forge bridge, the app-data invocation, and rendering.
Cold means a fresh connection; server-side Confluence caches were not forced cold.
One author created the seeded content, and actions ran without concurrent workload.
These data-path timings are not full user-experience timings or evidence of customer adoption.
